newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 22
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 22

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on January 22. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Vice-President Try Sutrisno has urged Indonesians to maintain unity in the multi-ethnic country.

President Suharto said Indonesia needd to set up "alert command centres" to monitor and nip unrest in the bud. Suharto said the centres would be stationed at district military commands to monitor situations and rumours which could incite social unrest.

Megawati Sukarnoputri is to lodge a protest with the Indonesian election commission against endorsement of the list of election candidates submitted by Surjadi, who ousted her from the helm of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI).

Indonesia's state-owned tin mining company, PT Tambang Timah, said it was ready to seek a 20 percent stake in the huge Busang gold find in Kalimantan if no agreement was reached by the Indonesian government and Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp to jointly develop the find.
Chairman of the Supreme Advisory Council Sudomo said recent unrest in the country is aimed at undermining and toppling the government.
